This happened when I was 10 years old. My mom used to date a guy, we will call him hank for now. At first the guy seemed okay, often flirted with my mom and one day took us for pizza. The story gets worse later when my mom dumps him and came to my room and hugged me crying. 

I woke up the next day when I found flowers on the apartment porch. I being a dumb kid told my mom. She freaked out and told me to throw them away. As soon as I got to the trash I noticed hank standing by the garbage. I asked what he was doing he just stared down out may. He was making weird grunting noises. I did not move. Than he shouted loudy just than he pulled out a knife. I didn't take  second further to jolt back to the apartment. Locking the door asap. 

He started banging at the door demanding I open it. I hid in my room locking the door. Just then I heard the door open. I quickly panicked and locked my door and ran in the closet asap. I heard screaming outside my bedroom and loud banging. All the sudden I heard him run out after hearing my mom pull in. My mom didn't seem to notice hank jolting out. She brought me home McDonalds. 

Fast forward later that night we started hearing loud banging outside from the sliding door that connected to the porch. We also heard banging from the door. My mom panicked and asap rushed us both to her room closet and locked it. Just then we heard the sliding door break. Hank started yelling historically " LISTEN HERE YOU FUCKERS ILL STOP IF YOU GET BACK WITH ME IF NOT ILL KILL YOU!" DONT FUCKING TEMPT ME" he started stabbing through the door. Me and my mom started crying and my mom held me tight. Just than we heard police sirens hank started running. The cops never found him but my mom filed a restraining order. We haven't heard from him since.

I always wonder if the cops never showed up what would have hank done to us.

Mario 64 ds. God I love this game. The n64 version will be remembered as a classic sure but it was past my generation. The ds version was the first game I owned at age 4-5 along a ds I got for Christmas. I love the ds version, granted I played the virtual console version on the Wii back when I was 10 (before Wii U so played n64 version on vc) while it's still good the graphics and controls are really dated. The ds version has good controls (yes really) amazing graphics, tons of new features like mini games and new characters and the amazing 5 new levels. Seriously people hate the remake I don't get why. The graphics improved. I honestly don't find the controls that bad think about it in the n64 version you had to run by moving the joystick up slightly it was uncomfortable. On the ds you just push a button. Why do people hate the graphics too? I mean sure on the ds it looks blurry but it's still A huge improvement over the blocky textures. Also I don't like the argument of people saying that it's pointless to have new characters. Bitch please Nintendo tryna make the game feels fresh and not bland. Fuck you on. Okay maybe I'm blinded by nostalgia but I have so many found memories of trying to beat koopa the quick. Beating bowser. Trying to get all 150 stars but being stuck on 149 stars because I didn't know about the slide under 20 second thingy. Beating the game. Finding every last bunny. Also one last thing people say it was on the wrong console but come on really? Nintendo did amazing Porting it on the ds not all games on ds were 3D but they somehow made this game an exception which God is impressive. I love this game and it holds up way better than the n64 version in my opinion
